llm_response.reason: The website mimics the appearance and branding of the real Bershka online store but uses a suspicious 'co.it' domain instead of the official 'bershka.com/it'. WHOIS data shows the domain was registered in 2025 with hidden details, not linked to Inditex. Typical scam signs include free returns offers, a wide range of products, and mimicking a legitimate brand to deceive shoppers. These match multiple scam website characteristics: handling multiple products, spoofing legitimate brand design, and ambiguous business registration details.
